## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2: On archive of a ticket, per-ticket scratch directory removed (or no-op if absent)

## Description

In the archive code path (plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-archive.sh or archive branch of ticket-lifecycle.sh), after archive event written/committed, invoke `_scratch_cleanup_for_ticket <id>`. Archive exit code MUST NOT be affected by cleanup helper.

Add RED test cases to tests/scratch/test-scratch-cleanup.sh:
- Populate scratch dir, run archive, assert dir gone, event committed.
- Second archive invocation on same id is idempotent (no-op, returns 0).

## TDD Approach
Given populated scratch dir; When archive runs; Then dir removed AND event committed. Given second archive on same ticket; Then returns 0, no further changes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format (N/A)
- [ ] Archive script calls _scratch_cleanup_for_ticket
  Verify: grep -rq '_scratch_cleanup_for_ticket' plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-archive.sh plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lifecycle.sh 2>/dev/null
- [ ] Archive-flow test passes end-to-end
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-cleanup.sh

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
|---|---|
| plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-archive.sh | Edit |
| tests/scratch/test-scratch-cleanup.sh | Edit |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 sonnet → opus → user.
data.title: Wire _scratch_cleanup_for_ticket into ticket-archive.sh
